title: I WON'T MARRY YOU!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Itsuki, from an ordinary household, is sent by his mother to work as a servant for the wealthy Tenmei family over his last summer break, without knowing he is one of the candidates to become the bride of the young master Jin; the other candidates are male omegas from prominent families (AniList and MangaUpdates summaries). A one-volume omegaverse boys' love comedy.
life_message: It holds up standing on one's own worth against class snobbery and choosing love freely (to verify).

content.note: Rivalry and an attempted assault (MangaUpdates Attempted Rape; details unverified).

Omegaverse arranged-marriage romance between young men; Itsuki described as a final-year high-schooler (MangaUpdates) or fresh graduate (AniList); attempted rape listed; MangaDex rates it safe; capped (to verify).
